name: button
title: Button
description: Button with variants, sizes, a loading state, and the option to render as a link.

name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: A menu of actions that opens from a button, with checkable items, radio groups, and submenus.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: Compact badge to show a status, count, or category.

name: card
title: Card
description: Group related content into a header, body, and footer.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: Show a key or shortcut styled like a keycap.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: Separate content with a horizontal or vertical line.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A round profile picture with a fallback for when the image is missing.

name: table
title: Table
description: A styled native table for rows and columns of data.

name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Stacked sections that expand and collapse with a smooth height animation.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Reserve space for content while it loads.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: Indicate loading with a CSS-animated SVG, no JavaScript.

name: alert
title: Alert
description: An inline message for information, success, or errors.

name: progress
title: Progress
description: A bar that shows how far a task has come, or that it is still working.

name: toast
title: Toast
description: Stacked notifications that dismiss themselves, with swipe and keyboard support.

name: input
title: Input
description: Text field with visual states for focus, error, and disabled.

name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Long text field that grows with its content, no JavaScript.

name: field
title: Field
description: Connect label, control, help text, and error with ids and aria attributes.

name: form
title: Form
description: Pass a Zod schema and validate fields without adding another form library.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Checkbox with checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.

name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Pick exactly one option from a small set, with arrow-key navigation.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: Toggle an option with immediate effect.

name: slider
title: Slider
description: Pick a number or a range by dragging a thumb or using the arrow keys.

name: select
title: Select
description: Pick an option from a list that opens from the button.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Modal window with managed focus that returns on close.

name: popover
title: Popover
description: A floating panel anchored to a button that can hold interactive content.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Show a short hint on hover or keyboard navigation.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Switch content with tabs and an indicator that follows the selection.
